title: pastinaca kochii subsp. latifolia
intro: Pastinaca kochii subsp. latifolia, commonly known as the broad-leaved parsnip, is a plant species in the carrot family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pastinaca kochii subsp. latifolia include its ability to protect against oxidative stress, modulate the immune system, and exert hepatoprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include falcarinol, falcarinone, and other sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
